votes.title: Approved $62.45 million FY2027 general fund budget
votes.text: Adds a grant writing service such as Langton and Associates ($60,000) and a state lobbyist such as Capital City Consultants ($90,000), with Requests for Proposals to be advertised within 30 days.

votes.title: Adopted tentative FY2027 budget with reduced general fund
votes.text: Resolution 20260908.7 adopts the tentative budget (the proposed budget, before the final hearing) for the city and Downtown Improvement Board and reduces the General Fund budget to $62,450,000.

votes.title: Motion to rebid using prior specifications failed
votes.text: The motion would have advertised for bids with the same specifications and information as the previous Request for Proposal, with internal engineers making the recommendation. Listed under the agenda item on litigation.

votes.title: Approved FY2027 budget for all other city funds
votes.text: Approves the Fiscal Year 2027 budget for all City of Panama City funds other than the General Fund.

votes.title: Awarded bid to H. G. Harders and Sons
votes.text: Awards the bid to H. G. Harders and Sons, Inc. with work to begin as soon as possible. Listed under the agenda item on litigation.

votes.title: Approved CBC Construction road reconstruction agreement
votes.text: CBC Construction will reconstruct Frankford Avenue and South Discovery Loop for a total of $1,718,585. Listed under the agenda item on the Redspeed agreement.

votes.title: Required weekly reports on budget line-item transfers
votes.text: Staff are to report all line-item budget transfers weekly until the December meeting and bring them back for review at the December 17, 2026 Commission meeting.

votes.title: Kept Capital City Partners as lobbyist this budget year
votes.text: Retains Capital City Partners as the city's lobbyist through the current budget year.

votes.title: Approved restructuring of the IT department
votes.text: Directs a restructuring of the Information Technology Department using one of the options presented or a fourth option to reduce cost and scope. Taken during discussion of a cost benefit analysis for IT services.

votes.title: Extended 6th Street and Harmon Avenue contract with MRS Enterprises
votes.text: Adds two years to the deadline for starting construction in the sales agreement with MRS Enterprises LLC for 6th Street and Harmon Avenue.

votes.title: Adopted final FY2027 property tax rates
votes.text: Resolution 20260922.3 sets the final millage (property tax rate) at 4.7999 mills for the City of Panama City and 3.0000 mills for the Downtown Improvement District for Fiscal Year 2027.

votes.title: Adopted the final FY2027 budget
votes.text: Resolution 20260922.4 adopts the final Fiscal Year 2027 budget for the City of Panama City and the Downtown Improvement District.

votes.title: Adopted tentative FY2027 property tax rates
votes.text: Resolution 20260908.6 sets the tentative millage (proposed property tax rate, before the final hearing) at 4.7999 mills for the City of Panama City and 3.0000 mills for the Downtown Improvement District for Fiscal Year 2027.

votes.title: The commission approved using $290,681.00 in fire permitting fees to buy fire department supplies and equipment and approved Budget Amendment Resolution 20260908.1.
votes.text: Approval to utilize Fire Protection Service permitting fees in the amount of $290,681.00 to purchase supplies and equipment for the fire department and approval of associated Budget Amendment Resolution 20260908.1.

votes.title: The commission approved accepting a $700,000 state grant for Robinson Bayou Bridge Refurbishment with a $149,515 match and approved the related budget amendment.
votes.text: Approval of Resolution 20260908.8 authorizing the City to accept a state funded grant for Robinson Bayou Bridge Refurbishment in the amount of $700,000.00 with an additional match of $149,515.00, and approval of Budget Amendment Resolution 20260908.9.

votes.title: The commission approved accepting a $650,000 state grant for a water storage tank with a $650,000 City match and the related budget amendment resolution.
votes.text: Approval of Resolution 20260922.1 authorizing the City to accept a state funded grant for a Water Storage Tank in the amount of $650,000.00 with an additional City match of $650,000.00 and approve Budget Amendment Resolution 20260922.2.

votes.title: The commission approved Budget Amendment Resolution 20260908.5 to receive and use $1,310.00 in donations for Parks, Culture and Recreation.
votes.text: Approval of Budget Amendment Resolution 20260908.5 to receive and utilize donations for Parks, Culture and Recreation in the amount of $1,310.00.

votes.text: Approval of Ordinance 3313, an ordinance adopting a temporary moratorium on large-scale data centers.

votes.text: Continue Ordinance 3315 to the October 27, 2026, Commission Meeting.

votes.text: Postpone the public hearing of the proposed Gateway Overlay Special Exception to the October 27, 2026, Commission Meeting.

votes.text: Approval of Ordinance 3312, an ordinance amending the Zoning Map to reflect a zoning designation of Neighborhood General, NG, for a property located at 2913 E 5th Court (Parcel ID 23267-000-000).

votes.title: The commission voted to continue the suspension of Transportation Impact Fees through January 2027.
votes.text: Approval to continue suspension of Transportation Impact Fees through January 2027.

votes.text: Approval to engage Emergency Medical Solutions, LLC to conduct a Fire Department Operational Assessment.

votes.title: The commission declared Art Marine a nonresponsive bidder and voted to advertise the bid for the project.
votes.text: Declare Art Marine a nonresponsive bidder and advertise bid for this project.

votes.title: The commission approved the Final Assessment Resolution for Fire Services No. 20260908.2.
votes.text: Approval of the Final Assessment Resolution for Fire Services No. 20260908.2.

votes.title: The commission approved Ordinance 3314 on final reading to correct a scrivener's error in the legal description for the Panama City North Community Development District.
votes.text: Approval of Ordinance 3314, amending ordinance 3305 regarding the Panama City North Community Development District to correct a scrivener's error in legal description.

votes.text: Approval of Amendment No 2 to Agreement No. LPA0204, "Panama City Relocation of Lift Station 79", between the City of Panama City and Florida Department of Environmental Protection.

votes.title: The commission voted to terminate and remove the Flock cameras and LPRs from State Rights of Way.
votes.text: Terminate and remove the Flock Cameras and LPRs from the State Right of Ways.

votes.title: The commission directed staff to return within 30 days with a cost benefit analysis of three solutions for the Information Technology Department.
votes.text: Direct staff to bring back a cost benefit analysis with three different solutions for improvement and efficiency of the Information Technology Department within 30 days.

votes.title: The commission approved the amended SHIP LHAP prepared for FHFC.
votes.text: Approval of the amended SHIP LHAP prepared for FHFC due to SB 594 passing during the 2026 FL Legislative Session.

votes.title: The commission voted that no dollars be dedicated to these efforts and directed staff to work with Bay County to unify the strategy.
votes.text: That no dollars be dedicated to these efforts in the City and staff work with Bay County to find a way to unify the strategy.

votes.text: Approval to direct staff to work with Commissioner Hughes and Lucas to identify a parcel for affordable housing.

votes.title: The commission directed staff to return with options for disposing of the remaining Flock cameras.
votes.text: Staff to return with a plan of options for the disposal of the remaining cameras.

votes.text: Approval of the revised Employment Agreement.

votes.text: Approval to empower the City Manager and Housing and Community Services Director to return with names to consider for the After School Assistance Program Board to the October 27, 2026, Commission Meeting.

votes.text: Reappoint Jerry Sowell to the Panama City Municipal Firefighters Pension Trust Fund Board to a four-year term that expires on September 24, 2030.
